samples.summary: Unrequested scope: opening image selection to read-only mounts (plus handle-less overlay, hover gate, resize-commit gate, new public `TextEditor.recordReadOnlyLinkAtMouse`) goes well past issue #870/#872's plan and acceptance criteria
samples.evidence: The issue (docs/tasks/active/20260829-docs-copy-paste-integrity-todo.md) states two defects and a two-step plan: cell-aware `getSelectedBlocks()` and image-aware copy/cut hooks. Its only read-only criterion is "Read-only Copy is offered in the context menu (it always worked)", which `docs-context-menu.tsx`'s `showCopy = hasSelection` already satisfies for a TEXT selection. The diff additionally removes `handleImageMouseDown`'s `if (readOnly) return`, adds a `readOnly` constructor arg to `DocCanvas`, a `handles` option to `drawImageSelection`, `readOnly` gates in `handleImageResizeMouseMove`/`MouseUp`/`handleImageHover`, and a new public `TextEditor.recordReadOnlyLinkAtMouse()` purely to repair link-following that the newly-claimed image mousedown broke for viewers. The change's own task notes record this surface as unpinned by tests ("Known coverage gap": "none of the three is pinned by a test"), and the context-menu design doc says the menu still never offers Copy for an image — so the viewer-facing behaviour change buys only the keyboard path, not the criterion that motivated it.

samples.summary: Stale-selection invariant is enforced by ~16 hand-written call sites, three documented exceptions and one cross-package call, rather than at a single funnel — the same defect class this PR has now re-fixed five times
samples.evidence: `clearImageSelectionForMutation()` must be called by every mutator: `insertLink`, `applySpellSuggestion`, `insertTable`, `deleteTable`, `insertTableRow/Column`, `deleteTableRow/Column`, `mergeTableCells`, `splitTableCell`, `insertImage`, `insertPageNumber`, plus `TextEditor.handleCut`/`applyPastePlan` via `imageSelectionClearer`; `undoFn`, `redoFn` and `resetAfterDocumentReplace` deliberately bypass it with a bare assignment; and `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-find-bar.tsx` calls the exported `EditorAPI.clearImageSelection()` because `FindReplaceState` lives outside the module. docs/design/docs/docs-image-editing.md states the rule as "Any future consumer that drives `FindReplaceState`, or the `Doc` directly, owes the same call" — an invariant with no enforcement point. A single funnel (clear on `invalidateLayout()`/doc-version change, or re-validate `selectedImage` on read as `imageSelectionProvider` already does) would remove the whole class and the frontend layering leak.

samples.summary: The new cell branch in `getSelectedBlocks()` re-implements the cell traversal `model/range-slices.ts` declares itself the single owner of, and the two now disagree about nested tables
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/model/range-slices.ts:1-17` opens with "The one traversal that decides which text a `DocRange` covers … Rather than keep two copies of the dispatch in sync, both sides drive this module", and its `visitRangeSlices` already handles the "Cross-block inside one cell" case (lines 165-190) via `blockParentMap` + the cell's block list. The copy path now grows a second copy of that dispatch, and deliberately differs: it resolves nested-table cells with `resolveNestedTableLayout` while `range-slices` documents that nested content is never visited. Two answers to "which blocks does this range cover" that will drift. The task doc argues the re-base was declined because range-slices is not nested-table-aware, but that is the divergence, not a defence of it — the alternative is to extend the canonical traversal.

samples.summary: Design-doc/code comment inconsistencies introduced by this change
samples.evidence: (a) The doc's `TextEditor` snippet annotates `imageSelectionClearer` as "Cut only" while the same doc's later prose and the implementation also call it from `applyPastePlan` for every paste path. (b) `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1251-1252` justifies the new focus call with "the issue #870 fix never runs on a read-only document — which is exactly where the context menu now offers Copy", but `docs/design/docs/docs-context-menu.md` (new Read-only section) states the menu never offers Copy for an image in either mode, so the cited justification does not hold as written. (c) `docs/tasks/active/20260829-docs-copy-paste-integrity-todo.md:335` still records "`getSelectedImage` / `updateSelectedImage` still call the throwing `doc.getBlock()`" as deliberately not done, while the diff converts both to `findBlock`.

samples.summary: The new #872 design-doc section does not record that the fix covers the body edit context only
samples.evidence: `getSelectedBlocks()` resolves against `this.getLayout()` (body layout), not `getActiveLayout()`, so a selection inside a table cell in a header/footer edit context still misses `blockParentMap`/`layout.blocks` and returns `[]`. The task doc names this ("extending #872 to the header/footer edit context" — not done), but the canonical design section added here presents the cell branch without that boundary, so the next reader will assume it is general.
